scope: Actual six Markdown verdict artifacts per completed sample, compared manually against supplied spec bodies, selected lenses and methodology critiques. Separate shape, slug and outcome assertions support but do not replace source comparison.

evidence_notes: Both plan acceptance strings retain Astra-low wording, but explicit provider/model/effort fields, design and inspected worker manifests specify fresh Sol-medium. This stale plan prose is an evidence inconsistency, not an artifact defect.
